profile.headline: JCG Web Services - Owner
profile.summary:
Independent Contractor - Digital Marketing - Ocean Conservation Advocate - Web & Graphic Designer.
- Self-taught and Nomad in essence. Based in Northern California, but since I have 3 citizenships and love Scuba Diving, I try to travel the world as much as possible. Always landing in places with good Internet access. :)
I have a company with my best friend from high school: JCG Web Services.
- As an independent contractor, we collaborate with diverse companies to boost their online presence and drive targeted traffic.
- We also work as sub-contractors for other web/graphic design companies.
- Lately we have decided to build websites using mainly WordPress and Elementor Pro. With just these tools you can do pretty much anything.
- JCG Web Services: Your Long-Term Digital Partner
At JCG Web Services, we believe in building lasting relationships with our clients. Our focus is on long-term collaboration, ensuring that your online presence thrives and evolves over time. Here’s how our process works:
1. Initial Contact: When a potential customer reaches out to us, we engage in a conversation to understand their unique needs and goals. Whether it’s a new website or an existing one that needs optimization, we listen carefully to their requirements.
2. Website Optimization: We specialize in creating websites that are not only visually appealing but also optimized for search engines. Our team ensures that your website ranks well, attracting the right audience and driving organic traffic.
3. Written Estimate: After discussing the project details, we provide a detailed written estimate. Transparency is essential to us, and we want our clients to know exactly what to expect in terms of costs and deliverables.
4. Project Kickoff: Once the estimate is approved, we begin working on the project promptly. Our team brings your vision to life, creating a website that aligns with your brand identity and business objectives.
5. Ongoing Maintenance and Updates: Our commitment doesn’t end with the launch. We offer website maintenance services to keep your site running smoothly. Regular updates, security checks, and performance enhancements are part of our routine.
6. Content Creation: A dynamic website needs fresh content. We can help you add value to your site through blog posts, articles, or even engaging videos. Our content experts ensure that your message resonates with your audience.
7. Long-Term Partnership: Rather than focusing on one-time gains, we prioritize building lasting relationships. Our goal is to be your trusted digital partner!
